integrity: Claims follow from a complete all-parameter overlap-and-defect argument; a standalone finite verifier checks direct cases and structural predictions. No outside verification or authorship certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The graph family is limited to labeled cycles of lengths k squared and k squared minus one, with proper time-labeled ignitions, k at least two, and exactly one ignition-location replacement per move. Findings do not determine reconfiguration for other cycle lengths or relaxed source conventions.
title: Factorial fragmentation of optimal cycle-burning schedules at one-site slack
